Package aor.proj3t.service.interfaces

Interface AIService

All Known Implementing Classes:
AIServiceImpl
public interface AIService
Service interface for AI microservice integration and artificial intelligence operations. This interface defines the contract for AI-powered functionality including sentiment analysis, machine learning predictions, chatbot interactions, and intelligent insights generation.

Key AI services include:

  • Sentiment Analysis: Text emotion and sentiment classification with polarity scoring
  • Training Recommendations: AI-powered training suggestions based on evaluation feedback
  • Performance Prediction: Machine learning models for future performance forecasting
  • Chatbot Integration: Natural language processing for user assistance and queries
  • Report Generation: AI-assisted report creation with data analysis and insights

This service acts as a bridge between the main application and the AI microservice, handling request formatting, HTTP communication, and response parsing to provide seamless AI functionality integration throughout the evaluation and training systems.

  • Method Details

    • analyzeSentiment

      SentimentResponseDTO analyzeSentiment(String text)
      Analyzes the sentiment of the provided text using AI microservice. Returns comprehensive sentiment metrics including polarity, subjectivity, and classification.
      Parameters:
      text - the text content to analyze for emotional sentiment and tone
      Returns:
      SentimentResponseDTO containing polarity score, subjectivity, and sentiment label
      Throws:
      RuntimeException - if communication with the AI service fails

    • recommendTraining

      TrainingRecommendationDTO recommendTraining(List<String> evaluations, List<String> skills, List<String> trainingsHistory)
      Generates personalized training recommendations based on evaluation feedback and history. Uses machine learning algorithms to suggest relevant training programs.
      Parameters:
      evaluations - list of evaluation comments and feedback text for analysis
      skills - optional list of user skills for personalized recommendations
      trainingsHistory - optional list of previously completed training programs
      Returns:
      TrainingRecommendationDTO containing suggested training programs and reasoning

    • predictPerformance

      PerformancePredictionDTO predictPerformance(List<Float> historicalScores)
      Predicts future performance trends based on historical evaluation scores. Employs time series analysis and machine learning for performance forecasting.
      Parameters:
      historicalScores - list of previous evaluation scores for trend analysis
      Returns:
      PerformancePredictionDTO containing predicted scores and confidence intervals

    • getChatbotResponse

      ChatResponseDTO getChatbotResponse(String message)
      Processes user messages through the AI chatbot for intelligent responses. Provides natural language understanding and contextual assistance.
      Parameters:
      message - the user's natural language message or question
      Returns:
      ChatResponseDTO containing the chatbot's intelligent response

    • generateReport

      ReportResponseDTO generateReport(List<Float> evaluations, List<String> comments)
      Generates comprehensive reports based on evaluation data using AI analysis. Creates intelligent insights and summaries from evaluation scores and comments.
      Parameters:
      evaluations - list of numerical evaluation scores for statistical analysis
      comments - optional list of textual comments for qualitative analysis
      Returns:
      ReportResponseDTO containing AI-generated report with insights and recommendations
